title: Maps: HashMap
bridge: Java's dictionary is the **HashMap**: `HashMap<String, Integer> kg = new HashMap<>();` then `kg.put("maize", 40)`, `kg.get("maize")`, `kg.containsKey(...)`, `kg.getOrDefault(key, 0)`. Loop with `for (var e : kg.entrySet())` and `e.getKey()`, `e.getValue()`.

exercises.title: Word counts
exercises.prompt: Write wordCounts(String text) returning a TreeMap<String, Integer> of how often each word appears (lowercase, split on spaces). Empty text gives an empty map.

tests.hint_if_fail: "".split(" ") gives one empty word: skip empty words.

exercises.title: Translate
exercises.prompt: A small English to Swahili map is set up in the starter. Write translate(String sentence): translate each word it knows (ignore capitals), leave others as they are. "the water is good" gives "the maji is nzuri".
hints: Split into words, look each up with SW.getOrDefault(w.toLowerCase(), w).
Join back with String.join(" ", ...) or a StringBuilder.

quiz.q: map.get(key) for a key that isn't there gives…
quiz.why: null; use getOrDefault to avoid it.
